channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: 2nd ODI: KL Rahul's magnificent 112 not out carries India to 284/7 against NZ
item.description: Wicketkeeper-batter KL Rahul struck a magnificent unbeaten 112 off 92 balls as India posted 284/7 in the second ODI against New Zealand at the Niranjan Shah Stadium in Rajkot on Wednesday.

item.title: KPHB Temple Theft Solved: Police Recover ₹26 Lakh Worth Ornaments, Interstate Gang Arrested
item.description: Kukatpally police cracked the KPHB temple theft case, arrested five accused, and recovered ₹26 lakh worth of gold, silver, and copper ornaments from an interstate gang.

item.title: Maha politics: Ajit Pawar drops irrigation 'bomb', BJP questions his silence for 25 years
item.description: In a sensational claim that has stirred Maharashtra's political circles, Deputy Chief Minister and NCP chief Ajit Pawar has accused the previous BJP-Shiv Sena alliance government of inflating the cost of an irrigation project by Rs 110 crore to collect "party funds."

item.title: Rahul becomes first Indian wicketkeeper to hit a century against New Zealand in ODIs
item.description: India’s dependable batter KL Rahul etched his name in the record books with a magnificent unbeaten century against New Zealand in the second match of the ongoing ODI series at the Niranjan Shah Stadium in Rajkot on Wednesday, becoming the first Indian wicketkeeper to score a hundred against the Black Caps in the 50-over format.

item.title: Police Seize 191 Banned Chinese Manja Bobbins in Hyderabad, Two Arrested in Yakuthpura
item.description: Hyderabad police arrested two persons and seized 191 banned Chinese manja bobbins worth ₹1.91 lakh in Yakuthpura. The accused were caught selling illegal kite strings.

item.title: Salar-e-Millat Gas Cylinder Scheme: Nampally MLA Majid Hussain Distributes LPG Cylinders and Helmets
item.description: Nampally MLA Majid Hussain distributed subsidised LPG cylinders to 800 families under the Salar-e-Millat scheme, along with helmets to promote road safety.

item.title: Fake Karachi Mehendi Manufacturing Unit Busted in Hyderabad, Goods Worth ₹8 Lakh Seized
item.description: Hyderabad police busted a fake Karachi Mehendi manufacturing unit in Balapur, seized duplicate cones and machinery worth ₹8 lakh, and arrested two accused.

item.title: Youth Dies in Bike Accident on ORR Service Road in Medchal District
item.description: A 23-year-old youth died after losing control of his bike near a speed breaker on the ORR service road under Keesara Police Station limits in Medchal district.

item.title: Hyderabad Auto Drivers to Observe City Bandh on January 20, Demand Total Prohibition
item.description: Auto drivers in Hyderabad have called a one-day city bandh on January 20, demanding total prohibition in Telangana and resolution of long-pending livelihood issues.

item.title: America Launches Phase Two of Gaza Peace Plan: Here’s What It Means
item.description: The United States has launched Phase Two of its Gaza peace plan, focusing on demilitarisation, technocratic governance, and reconstruction following the ceasefire.
